header.name: COMMUNICATION SKILLS
header.description: A Course designed to supplement and optimize the use of technical skills with the use of effective communication skills and thus enhance professionalism among our students and give them a head start in their careers.Theory Communication-it's importance and definition,model of communication, effectiveness of medium. Organisational communication- formal and informal channels. Barriers in Communication.Non Verbal communication-it's importance and relevance, Listening Skills, Presentation Skills, Group Discussion, Business Writing. Resume writing etc.Blog writing to develop written communication and language expression. Developing spoken skills in different contexts. outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students should be able to achieve basic comprehension skill and a essential competence in writing and speaking. They should be able to successfully attain a fair notion of grammatical correctness and how it contributes to coherence and clarity of expression. They should also be able to understand/comprehend a topic with no prior preparation.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are expected to actively engage with the techniques and strategies of effective communication in their approaches to a topic, a text, or ideas through listening, reading, evaluating, analysing, and applying the strategies of effective communication to both verbal (for example in a group discussion) and writing skills.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are expected to be able to critically engage in analytical writing in the format of reports, reviews, and short notes and documents, mind maps, and comments.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students are expected to present ideas/arguments in public on a substantially well understood, analysed and coherently prepared topic through a power point presentation, or participating in a debate.

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Students should be able to apply the strategies of effective communication to a. engaging in formal means of written communication including emails for specific official purposes; b. conducting and documenting other formal write ups like making resume, writing academic assignments in their respective disciplinary domains.
